_desc: /resume page — H1 + subtitle + embedded PDF (70vh iframe, rounded border).
_sources: Self-hosted PDF (content/files/mit_resume.pdf -> public/files/mit_resume.pdf) provided by Mit (2026-07-31), replacing the earlier resume. It powers both the clean on-page preview and the 'View' button (opens the PDF in a new tab, where it can be read and downloaded). driveUrl was cleared because the old Drive link pointed to the previous resume.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle (reference UI copy).
_fields.source: 'drive' | 'file' — which source powers the embedded preview.
_fields.driveUrl: Optional Google Drive share URL. When set, the 'View' button opens Drive instead of the self-hosted file. Empty = 'View' opens the self-hosted PDF.
_fields.file: Public URL path to the self-hosted PDF (content/files/ -> public/files/), e.g. '/files/<name>.pdf'.

subtitle: View and download my professional resume.
